Maltic's Well#000.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of much importance to you humans, being a villager settlement, but...my son!

Maltic's Well#002.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

similar.text: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

Maltic's Well#003.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The... the Beast-That-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!!

Maltic's Well#004.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing this cowl, and have warts.

Maltic's Well#005.src: I cannot thank you enough for your help!

Maltic's Well#006.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#007.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#007.dst: 请帮帮我们！我们几天前就请求 {p} 派守卫来了，可人类总是会忘了这个小村子。
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#008.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#008.dst: 上个星期，一个邪恶的女巫躲进了我们的老井。平常这倒不是什么问题……
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#009.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: 可她把我的孩子引进了井里！我唯一的孩子！他是在 Wynn 出生的，他可是 Wynn 的公民！
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#010.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#010.dst: 求你想想办法！我知道 {p} 是村民的聚落，对你们人类来说不重要，可是……我的儿子啊！
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#011.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#011.dst: 调查 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 老井，把 [{~} 女巫的空瓶子] 带给 Rynend

Maltic's Well#012.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#012.dst: 救命！谁来救救我！女巫好坏！！
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#013.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#013.dst: 我还在想他们什么时候会派出大名鼎鼎的 {p} 守卫呢。你永远抓不到我！
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#014.dst: 我不知道他们为什么叫我女巫。魔法到处都有，你知道吧。这孩子的爸爸嘲笑我的长相，所以我要把他儿子变成 Grook！
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#015.dst: 把我当女巫，我就做个女巫给你们看，可恶！你得先闯过我阴险的魔法防御才能找到我！
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#016.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#016.dst: 噢……糟了。那个法术我从来就没施对过。好吧，那你只能自己猜路了，呃，你这笨蛋！现在回头还来得及，因为，呃……
Maltic's Well#016.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#017.dst: ……因为如果你选错了门，就会被送到一头野兽面前，一头最邪恶的野兽！那个，呃……那个早午餐专吃 {p} 守卫的野兽！！绝对是！
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#018.dst: 噢……我就知道骗不了你。其实啊，我的魔法真的没那么厉害。我只是喜欢戴尖帽子，还长了疣。
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#019.dst: 要是这个村子的人对我没那么坏，我也不会被逼得住在这里。
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#020.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#020.dst: 我知道这是犯罪，可他爸爸和这里其他村民像追疯狗一样追着我！
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#021.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#021.dst: 我本来就没打算真把这孩子变成 Grook。我连让他长出一根羽毛都做不到。你看好了……
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#022.dst: 啊啊啊！我怎么了啊啊啊？！
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#023.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#023.dst: ……天哪居然成功了？？？？成功了，我这悲惨的一生总算施成了一次法术！！
Maltic's Well#023.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#024.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#024.dst: 等、等等，这一点都不好，你会……不！你别想活着把我带出去！
Maltic's Well#024.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#025.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#025.dst: 谢谢你把我从女巫手里救出来……她一开始对我很好，还给我做饼干，可是我现在想回家了。
Maltic's Well#025.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#026.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#026.dst: 噢，我的儿子！下面发生了什么？呃，你说她不是女巫？
Maltic's Well#026.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#027.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#027.dst: 荒唐！她戴着帽子还长着疣！我想现在说什么也晚了……非常感谢你的帮忙。
Maltic's Well#027.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#028.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#028.dst: 我没什么能给你当报酬的……希望我的感激就足够了！
Maltic's Well#028.speaker: Rynend
